rounds.q: How many years should a home smoke alarm last before you replace it?
rounds.why: The 10 years count from the date it was made, and it should be tested every month.
rounds.fun: Ten years on guard, with a little test every month. Good alarm!

rounds.q: Many car makers say to swap tires after how many years, even with good tread?
rounds.why: Tire makers allow up to 10 years, but tread can wear thin in just 3 to 4 years of driving.
rounds.src: AAA Oregon/Idaho, How Long Do Tires Last? (read 2026)
rounds.fun: Six years say many car makers, ten say the tire makers. Check those tires!

rounds.q: Dentists say to swap your toothbrush after how many months, at most?
rounds.why: The advice is every 3 to 4 months, or sooner if the bristles look frayed or matted.
rounds.fun: Every 3 to 4 months, or sooner if it looks frayed. Fresh brush time!

rounds.q: An LED bulb lasts up to how many times longer than an old-style bulb?
rounds.why: LEDs also use up to 90% less energy than old-style incandescent bulbs.
rounds.src: US Energy Information Administration, Today in Energy (2021)
rounds.fun: Up to 25 times the life on up to 90% less energy. Bright idea!

rounds.q: Power goes out. How many hours does food stay safe in a full, shut freezer?
rounds.why: A half-full freezer holds for only about 24 hours, and a closed fridge for just 4.
rounds.src: US Food and Drug Administration, Food and Water Safety During Power Outages and Floods (read 2026)
rounds.fun: About 48 hours if full, 24 if half full. Keep that door shut!
